title: Operator sees which dependency turned the replica unready by reading the readiness probe body
asA: operator debugging why a replica went unready under load-balancer rotation
iWant: the readiness probe response body to name each declared dependency, its individual pass/fail state, and when that state was last evaluated
soThat: I move from 'readiness is failing' to 'the payments-provider check has been failing since 14:02' in one step, without opening a shell on the replica

acceptanceCriteria.description: The readiness dependency set is declared at boot from application configuration; the application refuses to boot with a stable error code if the declaration is missing or if any declared entry lacks a name, and the declaration set is inspectable from the running process through the probe response.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the process is configured with a readiness dependency declaration that names each dependency
acceptanceCriteria.when: the readiness probe is hit after successful boot
acceptanceCriteria.then: the JSON body's checks object contains one entry per declared dependency, keyed by the dependency name from the declaration, with no additional keys and no missing keys

acceptanceCriteria.description: Each entry in the checks object carries a state field (one of pass or fail) and a checkedAt ISO-8601 timestamp naming when the per-dependency state was last evaluated by the background evaluator.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the readiness probe is hit against a running process with a mixed dependency state
acceptanceCriteria.then: every entry in the checks object has a state field valued pass or fail and a checkedAt field valued as a parseable ISO-8601 timestamp no older than the readiness evaluation budget declared in configuration

acceptanceCriteria.description: Dependencies not present in the readiness declaration never appear in the probe response and never affect the aggregate status.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the process depends on several downstream services but declares only a strict subset as readiness dependencies
acceptanceCriteria.when: the readiness probe is hit while an undeclared downstream service is offline
acceptanceCriteria.then: the undeclared service name never appears as a key in the checks object, and the aggregate status field remains pass so long as every declared dependency is passing
